reference.name: controlled 20/10 undefended-point model with independent 40% hit gate

interpretation: At the controlled 20/10 fixed-damage boundary, 102/55/3 zero/one/two-hit intervals match the predeclared 64%/32%/4% distribution implied by the validated point model and an independent 40% undefended hit gate. No 3+ hit interval appeared. This narrowly validates executable use of CHANCE_TO_AVOID_HIT_AT_NO_DEF=60 as a 40% undefended hit probability at O15.
